verdict.rationale: Dropbox exposes file deletion via its Files API and offers configurable 'days to restore deleted files' windows (30/180/365 days) across plans, giving users some control over data retention/deletion at the storage layer. However, there is no evidence of AI-specific data-retention or deletion controls (e.g., opting out of AI training use, deleting data ingested by Dash AI features, or retention policies tied to AI processing). Missing for 10: AI-specific retention/deletion settings, documentation on how AI features (Dash, summarization) retain or purge processed data, and independent confirmation that deletion requests propagate through AI pipelines.
